name: Design for Resource Constrained Populations
description: This course will elaborate on why ‘designing for developing nations’ is unique by introducing fundamental concepts like development and poverty from broader philosophical and theoretical perspectives. It will have both lecture and practical components. Students will work with a case study from a primary or a secondary source to understand the suitability of the design to resource-constrained populations. They will have to do immersion in the context, do primary research like interviews, focus groups, contextual inquiry, etc., to critique the design and then suggest possible improvements.
